notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Human token.
Repeat using the Human token instead.
